page_title: ARS 2-1 WOL | Arsenal v Wolves 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+4' Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves) makes a strong challenge and Peter Bankes blows for a foul.
90+3' Substitution. Bukayo Saka is replaced by Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal).
90+3' Here comes a substitution. Jorginho (Arsenal) is brought on as a substitute for Martin Odegaard.
90+3' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Thomas Doyle is replaced by Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves).
90+2' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Wolves players are visibly unhappy with the call.

90+2' Play continues despite the shouts by some Wolves players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Peter Bankes interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+1' Surely that's handball by one of the Arsenal players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
89' The resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
88' This is a yellow card! Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
86' 2 - 1 Matheus Cunha (Wolves) scores an absolute screamer from outside the penalty area, with the ball flying into the top left corner!
83' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Daniel Bentley.
79' Here is a change. Takehiro Tomiyasu is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Ben White (Arsenal).
78' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Substitution. Kai Havertz (Arsenal) has come on for Gabriel Martinelli.

75' What an opportunity! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
71' Corner kicks – 2:0.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by William Saliba (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Substitution. Gabriel Jesus makes his way off the pitch and Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.
66' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.

64' Declan Rice (Arsenal) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
63' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) replaces Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.
62' Substitution. Matt Doherty (Wolves) in, Hugo Bueno out.
62' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
60' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
58' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
57' Arsenal are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
53' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
52' The attendance is 60262.
48' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
48' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+7' What a chance that is! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
45+5' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Daniel Bentley intercepts the ball.
45+3' A neat pass is well received by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
45' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Good defending. Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) tries to find Bukayo Saka inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
42' Max Kilman (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' Max Kilman (Wolves) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
38' A dangerous looking corner kick from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared to safety by the defence.

37' Declan Rice (Arsenal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Arsenal can continue in their attacking effort.
37' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
36' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
33' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) whips the ball in from the free kick, but it goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
33' Peter Bankes blows the whistle, Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul.
31' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Wolves.
28' Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
27' Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
27' Arsenal have a free kick.
26' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Nelson Semedo (Wolves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
26' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
25' The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.
23' The manager makes a subsitution with Daniel Bentley (Wolves) coming on for Jose Sa.
22' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) sends a cross in and finds Gabriel Jesus inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
17' Arsenal enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
15' Jose Sa (Wolves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
14' Jose Sa (Wolves) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

13' 2 - 0 Goal! Oleksandr Zinchenko shows great vision to find Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
11' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) tries to find Bukayo Saka, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
9' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
6' The ball is cleared after Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) tries to find Gabriel Martinelli, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
2' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Peter Bankes got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
